description: Find fashion, accessories or interior pieces for a shopper's request. Use this first for any need stated in words ('a quiet luxury bag for work under $1,000'); use trending when there is no specific need, and find_similar to vary an item you already have. Hard filters (category, gender, tier, price, colors, size, brand, availability, ship_to) exclude items outright; filters.gender 'men' or 'women' also keeps unisex pieces unless gender_exact is true. Words like "men's" or "for her" in the query only rerank, like the optional taste_profile. Returns up to 20 items ranked by text match, taste and trend, each with price, availability, image, trend status, a one-line 'why' and an outbound_url to the retailer, where checkout happens. No pagination; an empty list means nothing fits, so loosen filters. Read-only. Without a key, results are capped at 5 and omit trend data and match reasons; a free key (POST https://vitrine.fashion/v1/keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>') unlocks them. Rate limits: 10 calls a minute anonymous, 60 with a key. With a key, each item also carries trend_reason (why it has its trend status), trend_sources (the signals behind it: source, url, signal type, date, contribution; [] when the status comes from curation alone) and trend_review (when the status last changed and whether a human reviewer approved it).

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

filters.description: Hard filters. Applied before ranking; an item that fails any of them is never returned.

colors.description: Item must come in at least one of these colors.

gender.description: Department: women, men or unisex. 'men' returns men's and unisex pieces, 'women' returns women's and unisex pieces, 'unisex' returns unisex pieces only. Set gender_exact to true to drop the unisex pieces.

gender_exact.description: With gender, true matches that department only, without unisex pieces.

size.description: Item must be available in this size, e.g. 'M' or '32'.

subcategory.description: Product type, e.g. 'coat', 'sneakers', 'vase'. Exact values: vocabulary.

limit.description: Maximum results, 1 to 20. Anonymous callers get at most 5. No pagination.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'relaxed linen trousers for a summer trip'. Max 300 characters.

anyOf.description:
Soft preferences from the shopper's agent. Used for ranking, never for exclusion.
Describe taste only: no names, emails or other personal data.

gender.description: Soft department preference (women, men, unisex): ranks that department and unisex pieces first, never excludes. Use filters.gender to exclude.

name: search

gender.description: Department. Accessories and interior are usually unisex.

outbound_url.description: Tracked link to the retailer's product page. Checkout happens there.

why.description: One-line reason it matches. With a key.
